summary: Traditional Latin Mass parish with one church. Sunday (8 and 10 AM with Confession and Adoration around each) and Saturday are fixed, but the website says weekday Masses vary, so only weekday slots printed in both bulletins are weekly and the rest of the Oct 12-16 calendar is dated.
